input_source.change_from_input: One shared 32-bit C4/C5 prefix gate before the original vector entry; forward C4 inside the 32-bit writer

input_source.qualification_reason: The previous shared-gate source was held at a text-footprint gate without native timing. This rebase completes full semantic checks before testing actual regressions; layout size alone is not a timing verdict.

Move 32-bit VEX dispatch after the existing padding, legacy-register and EVEX cases. The generated plan domain then makes a second C4/C5 prefix test redundant. Complete-state equality and native code/data geometry are checked before timing.

Keep original 64-bit descriptor storage exact and place the complete 32-bit descriptor pool in the new 32-bit object. Combine with the admitted-mode gate already validated in round1338; independently verify canonical records and native code/data geometry before timing.

Select a mode writer only at the existing vector call. Keep the existing vector writer object exact and pass its original constant register-array address. Unlike R1114 this has no mode-dependent register-row index or scanner change. Native code shape and timing remain separate requirements.

candidate.qualification_reason: Derive the writer index from the raw mode after existing mode validation, preserve constant register pointer and original vector runtime object. Source identity is checked against the frozen compiler-audit candidate. Native timing remains required.

review.scope: Early rejection pilot: 2 independent Clang18 allocations, diagnostic-only follow-up; full candidate remains held because Clang14 regresses, 5 real workloads, 7 panels, scan/format/detail on every panel, 2 launch controls; 21 balanced cycles. Full qualification remains required.
review.checksum_scope: Native timing checks instruction boundaries, rejections and selected consumed output values. Eight native owner units run on each binary. The separate local active-path probe compares complete cs_insn/cs_detail records, untouched bytes, cursors and errors for 162398208 inputs and guarded-page extents. These are distinct validation surfaces.

focused_native_summary.notes: The full source is held. The Clang18 diagnostic pilot does not erase the Clang14 losses or qualify a compiler-scoped source change.
